'''January 2001 San Jose tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in San Jose, California on 13 January 2001. [[Matt Smith]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1626">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-15-san-jose-ca-1-13-01d1626/ san-jose-ca-1-13-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 15 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-15-san-jose-ca-1-13-01d1626/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 January 2001
* '''Site:''' San Jose, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Smith]]
